research_insight_text_link.research_insight_description: Apptimize is researching run-time application modification, segmented customization, and user interface modification and usage tracking. Their work includes enabling applications to redirect operating system calls through a call handler and update module, providing different user experiences to groups of users via manifests from an optimization platform, and tracking events in user interfaces by associating event indicators with view selectors. These areas reflect a focus on dynamic app iteration and user experience optimization.

overview_description.description: Apptimize lets mobile teams increase revenue and engagement by iterating faster and smarter. Our mission is to enable you to optimize, deploy, and manage the features and UX of your native iOS and Android apps in real-time through instant updates, A/B testing, feature flags, and analytics. We work with top apps like the Wall Street Journal, Western Union, Flipagram, HotelTonight, Nokia, and Trulia.
